logManagement.description: Manage retention and automatic cleanup of activity and authentication logs.
logManagement.forbidden: Only Super Admin can access these settings.
logManagement.retentionHint: Applies to activity and authentication logs. The default is 90 days. Entries, revisions, and login sessions are not deleted.

logManagement.statusHint: Latest result as of the last refresh. Runs without a finish record are not treated as successful. Counts include committed deletions only.

status.skipped: The previous run skipped deletion because retention was indefinite
status.stale: No run confirmed for over 48 hours
status.interrupted: Run completion could not be confirmed
status.disabled: Automatic cleanup is disabled by indefinite retention
